sources.title: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-quantized.w8a16 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Optimizations This model was obtained by quantizing the weights of Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to INT8 data type. This optimization reduces the number of bits per parameter from 16 to 8, reducing the disk size and GPU memory requirements by approximately 50%. Only the weights of the linear operators within transformers blocks are quantized.
